title: Why Do You Always Feel Guilty? The Spiritual Cause (1981-03-31)
description:
Do you constantly criticize yourself or feel guilty for no reason? Discover why this happens in your subtle system and the powerful mantra to stop self-condemnation instantly.

Shri Mataji explores the Vishuddhi (throat) and Agnya (third eye) chakras, explaining how guilt and arrogance block our evolution. She reveals the deep spiritual connection between Shri Krishna and Jesus Christ, explaining how their combined powers help us witness life's drama and transcend the ego. Includes Q&A on cosmic consciousness.

Key Topics:
• 🌙 Understanding Left Vishuddhi - why we feel false guilt and the mantra "I am not guilty" to clear it
• ☀️ Right Vishuddhi - how aggressive speech and arrogance damage your spiritual connection
• 💭 Divine Diplomacy - how Shri Krishna used "tricks" in the Gita to break the disciples' ego
• 👁️ Agnya Chakra - how Jesus Christ sucks in our ego and superego to open the narrow gate
• 🚫 The spiritual dangers of clairvoyance, mediums, and communicating with the dead

“Divine diplomacy is a thing by which I also play tricks on you... I put you into such situations that you start seeing the point that you are missing the real goal.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Is Cosmic Consciousness the same as the Spirit?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to overcome guilt and self-blame spiritually?
• What is the connection between Krishna and Christ?
• How to balance the throat chakra vishuddhi?

Do you find yourself leaning more towards feeling guilty (Left side) or being aggressive (Right side)? How do you try to find balance?

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1981 in Maccabean Hall, Darlinghurst (Australia).
